=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Resolve the positional remote and effective push refspec using the command's inline Git configuration; automatically deny the push if that mapping cannot be determined."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_push_targets line 573-574
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: DeepSeek says the branch treats all positionals as refspecs without resolving `positionals[0]` as a configured remote; GLM says the LAST RUN DIFF resolves `positionals[0]` as a remote even when `--repo` already selected the remote, though Git treats positionals as refspecs in that case.
- requirement: "Coverage should include -c, --config-env, and inline GIT_CONFIG_* assignments; automatically deny pushes when their mapping cannot be determined."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_guarded_git_invocations, _evaluate_bash
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The env parsers match only bare `env`, do not parse env options, and `_evaluate_bash` has no `env -S` check; `/usr/bin/env`, `env -u`, `env -i`, and `env -S` forms are reported to evade the guard.
- requirement: “Automatically deny the push if that mapping cannot be determined.”
  expected_change_site: `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_guarded_git_invocations`, `git_subcommands`, and `_evaluate_bash`; mirrored in `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The env-option parsers stop on unsupported options without blocking or identifying the following Git command; `_evaluate_bash` only explicitly rejects `env -S` forms, so a valid unsupported option such as `env --debug` leaves the mapping unresolved but the push is allowed.
- requirement: "Resolve the positional remote and effective push refspec using the command's inline Git configuration; automatically deny the push if that mapping cannot be determined."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_push_targets (`remote_provided and positionals and invocation.config` branch)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN DIFF resolves `positionals[0]` as a remote even when `--repo` already selected the remote; the requirement is to resolve the POSITIONAL remote only when no `--repo` is given and to preserve the `--repo` remote while treating positionals as refspecs.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 1560-1565
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: default_branch(target.cwd) runs inside with _git_environment(target.environment, target.config), passing attacker-controlled inline Git configuration (core.sshCommand, core.gitProxy) to the network-bound git ls-remote probe.
  WHY: An inline core.sshCommand=untrusted-helper on git push origin feature/x causes the guard to execute untrusted code during the default-branch network lookup before the authorization decision.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 1560-1565
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Same as above — the template copy has the identical defect. default_branch(target.cwd) runs inside the inline config context on the network-bound probe.
  WHY: Same exploit path as the live hook.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 573-574
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When --repo is present with inline -c config, _push_targets treats ALL positionals as refspecs: refspecs = positionals. The first positional is never resolved as a remote. The exploit command from the linked issue — git -c remote.main.url=<origin-URL> -c push.default=current push --repo=origin main — treats main as a refspec branch, checking origin/main, while Git uses the inline-defined remote.main.url and pushes the current feature branch to it.
  WHY: The guard inspects the wrong branch on the wrong remote, skips the merged-PR check, and allows a push from a merged feature branch.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 573-574
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Same as above — the template copy has the identical refspecs = positionals bypass.
  WHY: Same exploit path.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 409
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _guarded_git_invocations matches tokens[index] == "env" but not /usr/bin/env. An absolute-path env command carrying GIT_CONFIG_* assignments escapes both parsers and reaches the push without inline config detection.
  WHY: /usr/bin/env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=remote.main.url GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=x git push origin feature/x runs without the merged-PR guard inspecting the effective remote and branch.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 409
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same as above — the template copy matches only bare env.
  WHY: Same exploit path.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: 817
  severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: git_subcommands matches tokens[index] == "env" but not /usr/bin/env. Commands with absolute-path env and inline Git configuration are invisible to the subcommand parser, so _evaluate_bash returns early when guarded_git_subcommands is empty.
  WHY: The command evades detection at the subcommand-gate, so the push proceeds without any merged-PR check.
